info.title: Store Builder API
info.description: Versioned API (v1). Scopes: /api/v1/auth, /api/v1/me, /api/v1/admin (merchant), /api/v1/store (shoppers), /api/v1/platform (operators). State-changing requests must come from the platform origin (Origin check). Errors have one shape (ErrorV1) with a fixed code and a Persian message.
